dynamic_parameters.name: Physical health-checkup clinic / hospital screening network
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Determine whether the competitor operates or contracts a physical health-checkup (ningen dock) or hospital-based screening network in Japan, and quantify scale (clinic count, annual screening volume).

dynamic_parameters.name: Participation in government / public-health screening schemes
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Identify whether the competitor delivers services under national or municipal public-health screening programs (e.g., MHLW cancer screening, tokutei kenshin) and list named contracts.

dynamic_parameters.name: DTC genetic / at-home diagnostic test offering
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Confirm whether the competitor sells direct-to-consumer genetic or at-home diagnostic kits (mail-in stool, urine, saliva, blood spot, microbiome, genetic) and list product SKUs and channels.

dynamic_parameters.name: Wearables / continuous health-monitoring device offering
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Document any wearable or continuous-monitoring device the competitor sells or integrates (smartwatch, CGM, patch) and what physiological biomarkers it captures.

dynamic_parameters.name: Insurer-led wellness / preventive-care program
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Identify whether the competitor is an insurer (or operates insurer-bundled programs) running wellness / preventive-care benefits, and quantify covered lives or enrolled members.

dynamic_parameters.name: PHR / health-app / claims-analytics point solution
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Determine whether the competitor offers a PHR app, consumer health-record platform, or claims-analytics product, and capture product names plus registered-user or covered-claims volume.

dynamic_parameters.name: Hospital network / EMR data exclusivity partnerships
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: List named hospital-network or academic medical center partnerships the competitor has secured for clinical / EMR data access, noting any exclusivity or first-look terms and the scale of records covered. This addresses the race to lock up hospital data partnerships.

dynamic_parameters.name: Diversified-conglomerate / trading-house medical-data platform activity
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Document whether the competitor is (or is backed by) a diversified trading house / conglomerate building a national medical-data platform, including platform name, disclosed cumulative investment, and announced scale targets.

dynamic_parameters.name: Employer-sponsored preventive screening / wellness contracts
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Capture named employer / corporate health-cost-management contracts the competitor has signed for preventive screening or wellness, with covered-employee counts where disclosed.

dynamic_parameters.name: Multi-cancer early detection / liquid-biopsy product and approval status
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Identify any multi-cancer early-detection or liquid-biopsy diagnostic the competitor has developed, licensed, or distributes, including regulatory status in Japan (PMDA), US (FDA), and other markets, with clinical trial registry IDs.

dynamic_parameters.name: Vertical integration across diagnostic test IP and clinical delivery channel
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Document whether the competitor owns both proprietary diagnostic test IP AND the clinical delivery channel (owned clinics, phlebotomy network, telehealth flow), evidencing vertical integration vs. third-party dependency.

dynamic_parameters.name: Ownership structure: single-owner vs. JV governance
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Determine whether the competitor is a single-owner standalone entity or a joint venture, naming parent owners and any disclosed governance / control split.

dynamic_parameters.name: Pharma RWD / biomarker data-licensing customers and revenue
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Capture evidence the competitor licenses real-world / biomarker / genomic data to pharma, including named pharma clients, disclosed deal values, and the specific data assets sold.

dynamic_parameters.name: Longitudinal biomarker / genomic dataset scale
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Quantify the scale of any longitudinal biomarker, genomic, or PHR dataset the competitor owns: number of unique individuals, years of follow-up, and biomarker categories captured.

dynamic_parameters.name: Japan secondary-use / APPI data compliance posture
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Confirm whether the competitor is registered/authorized under Japan's Next Generation Medical Infrastructure Act (anonymized medical-data authorized business operator) or holds analogous APPI secondary-use approvals.

dynamic_parameters.name: Telecom / network-infrastructure distribution partnership
dynamic_parameters.prompt_hint: Identify whether the competitor has a distribution or co-marketing partnership with a major telecommunications / network-infrastructure group for healthcare services, naming partner and scope.

dynamic_parameters.name: Outlet-level switching and metering depth

dynamic_parameters.name: Rack PDU manufacturing footprint locations
